status: PROPOSED by Claude from eval/rule_cards.json includes/excludes - pending user review

chunks.text: Lower the rear knee toward the ground during the descent of the lunge.
chunks.label: relevant
chunks.reason: Matches fixes/correct_form: back knee lowered toward the floor. Tagged |straight_back_leg|.

chunks.text: Performing the lunge with spinal flexion or excessive spinal extension.
chunks.label: irrelevant
chunks.reason: Spine rounding/arching: no lunge rule; forward_trunk_lean card excludes rounding/arching without a forward lean.

chunks.text: Allowing the front knee to go forward past the toes during the lunge.
chunks.label: irrelevant
chunks.reason: Front-knee travel past the toes. No rule measures it; excessive_front_knee_flexion includes it only when tied to over-bending (open question oq1). Text does not tie it.

chunks.text: Allowing the front knee to translate forward in front of the toes during the descending phase of a forward step lunge.
chunks.label: irrelevant

chunks.text: Allowing excessive anterior knee translation where the knee exceeds the toes during lunges.
chunks.source: Effects of Loading Positions on Lower Limb Biomechanics During Lunge Squat in Men with Different Training Experience
chunks.label: irrelevant

chunks.text: Turning the lead foot or lead knee inward during a forward lunge increases the torque stress of the knee joint of the front leg, which can exacerbate previous knee injuries and lead to increased knee pain.
chunks.label: irrelevant
chunks.reason: Front knee caving/turning in: excluded by every lunge card, no rule. Likely source of the 'knee twisting' explanation.

chunks.text: The forward lunge involves calcaneal eversion, talar plantar flexion and adduction, tibial internal rotation, knee flexion, extension, and abduction, and hip flexion, extension, and adduction.
chunks.label: irrelevant
chunks.reason: Generic joint kinematics of the lunge, says nothing about the rear knee staying straight.

chunks.text: Rotating the back knee or foot outward during a forward lunge increases torque stress in the knee joint, which can limit performance, exacerbate pre-existing injuries, and potentially cause pain.
chunks.label: wrong_fault
chunks.reason: About the back knee but rotation, not straightness; card excludes rear foot position on its own. relevance_pool (old code 'insufficient back knee flexion') also labels it wrong_fault. Likely source of the 'knee twisting' explanation.

chunks.text: Forward lean of the trunk during the forward lunge results in greater recruitment of the hamstrings.
chunks.source: Trunk and Shank Position Influences Patellofemoral Joint Stress in the Lead and Trail Limbs During the Forward Lunge Exercise
chunks.label: wrong_fault
chunks.reason: Trunk lean research - forward_trunk_lean includes it.
